Rule: a bridge may only touch entries listed here, and every entry must cite
the upstream declaration that makes it public. The authoritative sources are
Anything that cannot be pointed at in those catalogs is private and must not
be used. `internal/*` events are always forbidden.
scripts/api-surface-check.mjs enforces this list against lib/:
- services and events by literal id, plus the `serviceForAgent(agent, 'id')`
- members through the local aliases of those services
- the denylist below, as raw strings
`sessionMethods` records the declared session-log accessors for review; it is
not scanned mechanically — the `session.events` denylist entry is what catches
a regression in how the log is read.
frameworkNote: Cordis framework built-ins (cordis / cordis-plugin-loader), not harness surface.
